title: Approve the system architecture
decision: Python 3.13 with aiogram 3.31; modular monolith in one image; PostgreSQL as store and queue without Redis; shared full-standings fetch with local filtering; edit-in-place with coalescing; long polling on the home PC; Telegram Serverless not used as the backend
context: Bot API 10.3 library support measured; Codeforces forbids server-side filtering; Serverless lacks a scheduler; one maintainer
rationale: Smallest set of moving parts that meets the functional requirements and the latency targets
